instructions:

Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "きゃああっ！！ ま、待ってっ……今なに言おうとしたか、飛んじゃったじゃないっ！". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: LOUD, sudden high-pitched anime shriek of shock and surprise at the start (like someone suddenly grabbing her on a roller coaster), open-throat bright vocal projection — NOT a whisper! Followed by a flustered, breathless rush of words. No music or background noise.
